variable_coverage.construction: Solve the 12-year EBO residual-income valuation for the annualized June IRR using stock price, latest book value per share, I/B/E/S mean FY1/FY2, year-3 forecast via Ltg/fallback, 5–10-year profitable FF48 moving-median ROE, clean-surplus book values and latest-FY payout; subtract June month-end 10-year Treasury yield. The current-share source conflicts (page 9 I/B/E/S; sample section CRSP).
Market-beta coefficient from the separately assessed five-year monthly rolling support regression; transformations and endpoints are unspecified.

Natural log of latest-fiscal-year total long-term debt divided by June-formation total market equity. Quarterly debt and CRSP price/shares are candidate fields; exact cutoffs/units are not fully mapped.
Natural log of market capitalization in millions at portfolio formation, using CRSP price and shares candidates; scale and adjustment convention are unverified.
Natural log of current FY1 analyst forecast coefficient of variation (STDEV/MEANEST candidate) as of the June statistical period; I/B/E/S codes and zero/negative handling are unspecified.
I/B/E/S mean LTG when available; otherwise preserve stated FY2/FY1 fallback and omit fallback cases with negative FY1 or FY2. Whether to subtract one is unresolved.
Natural log of B/M. Quarterly Compustat is named, but the book-equity field and market-value date are unspecified; candidate fields are not treated as a verified map.

Previous-year equal-weighted average firm-level implied risk premium within the same FF48 industry; recompute across the full prior-year valuation population, not from the time-series Table 2 average.
Monthly CRSP stock-return outcome for each security in the five-year rolling regression. RET/RETX are candidate fields; the paper does not say raw versus excess or exact month inclusion.
Monthly value-weighted CRSP NYSE/AMEX market proxy. MSI vwretd/vwretx are candidate fields but the catalog describes a multi-exchange product and the paper omits raw/excess treatment.

design_coverage.reason: The paper requires U.S. non-ADR firms at the NYSE/AMEX CRSP and annual-industrial Compustat intersection, core accounting/CRSP fields and FY1/FY2 I/B/E/S forecasts. Historical filters and code mappings remain unresolved.
GVKEY/PERMNO/TICKER must be joined at valid historical dates; link columns exist but link-type/score selection and population match are unverified.
No separate industry fixed effects are reported. Indus is the prior-year average implied risk premium for the firm’s FF48 industry.
No cross-sectional cluster dimension is reported; the paper gives Newey–West autocorrelation-adjusted t-statistics across annual estimates without specifying bandwidth.
No observation weights are reported for the annual Table 7 Panel A cross-sectional fits.
The paper reports annual Fama–MacBeth cross-sectional fits and time-series mean coefficients; the estimator for each annual fit is not named.
Panel A uses natural logs for D/M, Size, Disp and B/M; Beta, Ltg and Indus are in levels. Nonpositive-log handling, field codes and scaling units are unreported.

implementation_issues.description: The ln(B/M) book-equity field and market-value date are unspecified; quarterly Compustat candidates do not resolve this retained predictor.

The EBO definition attributes current-month shares outstanding to I/B/E/S, while the sample section attributes shares to CRSP. The I/B/E/S summary probe has no share-count column; CRSP SHROUT is a candidate, not a resolution.

Indus requires the prior-year industry mean; the first 1979 fit therefore needs 1978 values although the stated valuation sample begins in 1979. The exact prior-year population is unreported and Table 2 gives time-series averages, not the annual series.
The paper cites Fama/French (1997), but current public FF48 definitions reflect later classification changes. The exact historical vintage and SIC assignment policy used in the paper are unresolved.

The Table 7 note lists eight characteristics including log(D/B), but displayed Panel A headers and the Model 1–3 sequence omit D/B. The frozen seven-term RHS is preserved and the source conflict is recorded.
The within-year Fama–MacBeth estimator and Newey–West lag/bandwidth are not specified, so exact coefficient estimation and reported inference are not both recoverable from the source.

For missing Ltg, the source says FY2/FY1 but elsewhere calls the fallback the growth rate implicit in FY1/FY2; it does not say whether to subtract one. Preserve the printed ratio wording pending a source-correct resolution.
The sample requires date-valid Compustat-to-CRSP and I/B/E/S-to-CRSP links plus NYSE/AMEX and ADR filters. Link selection and code mappings are not reported.

Current Compustat/I/B/E/S/CRSP files do not establish original historical point-in-time coverage. The annual-industrial population statement and Table 7 quarterly-accounting note must both be represented.

review_notes: The original PDF Table 7 page image was inspected because the table header/note is not fully preserved in extracted text. Displayed Panel A Model 3 has Beta, ln(D/M), ln(Size), ln(Disp), Ltg, ln(B/M), and Indus; it omits D/B although the note lists eight characteristics.
The paper’s Table 2 average-over-time is not used as a substitute for the annual lagged Indus series.
All local access/field claims link to exact shared probes or the bounded CRSP.MSENAMES probe; no historical/population coverage is confirmed.
